_comment: Bundled startup tips and author project notices shown occasionally in the interactive TUI. Static file only — no network requests or telemetry. Set ANTICRUMB_NO_NOTICE=1 to disable.

entries.text: Use @git:diff+ or @git:HEAD~1+ for AST-aware cross-file diffs.
Press Enter mid-turn to queue a steering message (supports @file).
Use /provider to switch between Gemini, Claude, and ChatGPT accounts.
Run /temp on for anonymous chats (no server history; persisted).
Press Ctrl+O for fullscreen Tool Inspector, or Alt+I to toggle panel.
In /model, use Up/Down for models and Left/Right for thinking effort.
Run /copy to copy the last response with original Markdown intact.
Use /new for each task to keep context sharp; revisit via /resume.
Fine-tune Agent access with /permissions (read, edit, shell, browser).
Customize agent prompts with /prompts init or project AGENTS.md files.
